Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare
Artificial Intelligence (AI) is transforming the healthcare industry by improving diagnosis, treatment
planning, patient monitoring, and hospital management. Machine learning models help doctors
detect diseases such as cancer, diabetes, and heart conditions from medical images and clinical
data. Natural Language Processing (NLP) enables healthcare providers to analyze electronic health
records, summarize medical reports, and extract important patient information. AI-powered virtual
assistants support appointment scheduling and patient queries, while predictive analytics helps
identify high-risk patients before complications occur. Although AI offers significant benefits,
challenges such as data privacy, security, ethical concerns, and model bias must be addressed.
With responsible implementation, AI has the potential to improve healthcare quality, reduce costs,
and enhance patient outcomes.
